places.lookup: Exact casefold match on name or aliases; return all stable-ID-sorted matches; no match returns known display names.

line_prior.assumption: Unknown initial location is uniform along approved arclength; dementia feature conditioning follows the radial initialization.
line_prior.formula: m_i = A_i * sum_j(w_j * mean_q rho(||x_iq - s_j||^2)); w_j = segment_length/(sample_count * total_length); M = sum_i m_i; p_i = m_i/M.
line_prior.normalization: Weights sum to one. Average unconditioned radial cell masses before world conditioning; retained mass is M. Existing single-point prior is the one-support case.
line_prior.quadrature: Midpoints of segments divided so each interval is no longer than the shortest grid-cell side. The line midpoint is a map anchor only.

places.directions: Horizontal exact nearest point/segment/polygon distance; compass direction of feature-to-location displacement and side of nearest polyline. Open endpoints identified separately. Creek banks are geometric compass sides, not downstream left/right. No walkable route is inferred.
places.hero_profile: Age 74 in the exact father-comma-age-comma quotation is supported; time, duration and separate quotation fragments do not supply age.
places.height_contract: Required finite heightM; positive-height landmarks require authored polygon footprints. Trail, road, creek and pond heights are zero. No invented widths or footprints.
places.missing_catalogue: Missing public data is visible and blocks place lookup, dementia feature planning and flight-clearance checks. A new mission reloads integrated authored data.

headline.region_rule: Sum the whole probability of every positive-area grid cell intersecting the closed 95% location ellipse; includes tangency.
headline.measurement_scope: Current intersection code applied to the accepted recorded localization and grid; probabilities are read from the preserved first-positive audit, not re-estimated or re-inferred.

verbatim_source_passages.quote: In an urban environment, the subject is typically found in structures or walk- ing along roads. In both urban and wilderness environments, the subject is highly likely to cross or depart from a road (66%).47 If the subject leaves the road or travel feature, he does not travel far. He may often go unnoticed unless his dress is highly unusual. Track offset statistics for dementia are the shortest of all subject categories. In the wilderness, the subject is typically walking or gets stuck in brush/briars or drainages. Structures are common. Subjects are also attracted to water features and will walk into water (perhaps without even realizing it is water). They are generally mobile for only a short period of time. In temperate domains, half of the subjects are mobile for less than an hour. In dry domains, subjects remain mobile longer.
Currently, the ISRID database provides no guidance (or weight) to local history, decision points or terrain analysis.
verbatim_source_passages.verification: Visually transcribed from limitations-page-1.png. The sorted PDF extractor inserted the preceding paragraph drop-cap T between no and guidance; the original extracts.json is preserved.

verbatim_source_passages.quote: This is the first time results are presented by temperate or dry domain (Chapter 2). If the searcher is in a polar domain it is suggested to use the dry domain result. If in a tropical domain the temperate domain result will be the best fit. In addition, separate results for urban searches are presented. Chapter 7 describes in detail how all the data was obtained and organized. All data and results are derived from ISRID unless otherwise cited in the specific result table.
Bailey, Robert. 1995. Description of the Ecoregions of the United States. 2nd ed., revised. Misc. Publication No. 1391. Washington, DC: United States Department of Agriculture.

ecoregion.rationale: Sierra Nevada is within the named humid-temperate mountain province. A summer-dry Mediterranean climate is not by itself the Bailey Dry Domain. model.status: Supportable only as an explicitly provisional marginal mixture, not a source-validated terrain behavior model.
model.base: r_i is the existing in-world radial cell probability. Its retained unconditioned in-world massR is preserved separately.
model.linear_classes: Map Linear to authored trail polylines, Road to road polylines, Drainage to creek polylines. The Linear→trail and Drainage→creek crosswalks are declared ontology assumptions.
model.linear_exposure: e_ki=g(d_ki)/g(0), using horizontal exact distance to the nearest polyline of that type and derivativeg of a monotone interpolated CDF through printed track-offset knots.
model.areal_classes: Structure, Woods and Water require authored polygon geometry; use polygon-cell overlap exposure, with Structure→structure, Woods→forest, Water→pond declared crosswalks. No point is assigned an invented physical footprint.
model.unresolved: Brush 6% and Field 14% remain a 20% unresolved radial component when no authored classification exists. They are not re-labelled as all unmarked land or discarded.
model.effective_area: A_k=sum_i a_i e_ki. For a linear class this is effective kernel exposure area, not a measured corridor width.
model.normalization: Z_k=sum_i r_i e_ki/A_k; q_i=w_unresolved*r_i+sum_k w_k*(r_i*e_ki/A_k)/Z_k. Each component sums to one, class weights sum to one, so q sums to one. A_k cancels algebraically after per-component normalization; calculate each component with one normalization and report A_k separately.
model.out_of_world: Use R*q_i for unconditional in-world mass, leaving outside mass 1-R unchanged.
unknowns: Joint dependence of radius, track offset and find class is unmeasured.
Track-offset endpointF(0)=0 and upper 5% tail shape are interpolation assumptions.
Separate creek, trail and road offset likelihoods are unavailable.
The briefing tendency to follow water supplies no calibrated numerical multiplier.
Dementia mobility/dispersion marginals do not identify dynamic transition probabilities.
If a supported polygon or linear class is missing, fail that feature prior explicitly rather than inventing geometry or silently redistributing its weight.
model.input_constraints: All six mapped source classes must be present. Areal classes require polygons. Overlapping or touching polygons within one class and partially fence-clipped probability cells fail explicitly.
model.offset_interpolation: Cubic Hermite CDF in distance with PCHIP slopes and the final secant slope; exact published percentile knots and a derivative-matched exponential 5% tail. F(0)=0 and tail shape are modeling assumptions.
model.quadrature: Line exposure averages the offset density at four quarter-cell sample points; each sample uses exact horizontal segment projection with endpoint caps.

domain_policy.rule: Unsupported local category/domain tables fail explicitly; no Australian or dry-domain substitution.

source_basis.support: Qualitative travel-corridor/track investigation and scarcity of verifiable clues; no deposition-time or clue-association likelihood.
Investigation, IPP, destination/route and determining direction of travel are planning inputs.

clue_design_only.meaning: A confirmed personally attributable cap is evidence of passage near c at an unknown deposition time τ; it is not a detection of the current position.
clue_design_only.formula: p_t(x|C,D)=[integral_{t0}^{tfound} w(τ) integral KΣ(c-y) p(Xτ=y,Xt=x|D)dy dτ] / [integral_x integral_{t0}^{tfound} w(τ) integral KΣ(c-y) p(Xτ=y,Xt=x|D)dy dτ dx].
clue_design_only.terms: D is prior search evidence; KΣ is measured clue-localization error; w is a documented deposition-time likelihood; the joint path prior represents subject movement and barriers. Normalize over all states including outside-world mass.
limits: No published clue-deposition-time distribution, subject-specific transition kernel or false-attribution rate was identified in these sources. Do not invent w or a speed from the mobility percentiles.
Do not reset the current location to the clue point or grant camera detection credit.
Repeated photographs of the same confirmed clue are one passage observation.
Implement only after justified time/path/attribution inputs exist; otherwise retain it as an operator-visible investigation lead.

quotes.quote: The choice of search pattern is the prerogative of the SMC, who may elect to use only one pattern or several patterns simultaneously but in different areas.

Parallel track search patterns can be used for searches involving one or a group of search assets and are the simplest patterns available. The pilot/coxswain of a search vessel steers straight courses or search legs, each leg being one track spacing from the other.
This procedure is referred to as an expanding square search as it begins at the reported position or most probable location and expands outwards in concentric squares.

The first two legs are held to a distance equal to the track spacing and every succeeding two legs are increased by another track spacing. Turns may be to the left or right, depending upon the observer positions.

Scanning should start at a distance of "S" before reaching the most probable position to avoid leaving an area not scanned near the start point. Observers should be briefed to pay particular attention to the areas outwards of each turn to avoid leaving areas not scanned.
To minimise navigational errors, the first leg is usually oriented directly into the wind.

preliminaries.quote: It has been developed with due regard to the International Aviation and Maritime Search and Rescue Manual (IAMSAR).

primary_source.source_scope: Primary national SAR procedure source explicitly developed with due regard to IAMSAR. Original ICAO/IMO IAMSAR text was not retrieved; do not attribute these verbatim quotes to that book.
primary_source.fleet_scope: The S,S,2S,2S,... right-angle leg construction follows the source; clipping that geometry to four fixed separated sectors and concurrently assigning those pieces to four drones is an implementation adaptation, not a sourced IAMSAR fleet algorithm.
notes: Coordinate first leg with wind when wind is modelled; otherwise state chosen orientation.
Source recommends scanning S before datum. If omitted because requested pattern starts at LKP and ingress receives no camera credit, state that modelling difference.

Source identifies parallel-track as aligned to major axis and creeping-line as aligned to minor axis (4.5.8). If optimizing either axis call the baseline parallel/creeping-track lawnmower, or report which orientation won.
